evidenceClass: Fictional company comparison assumptions and estimates; no observed business benefit or company source evidence.

actualLabConstraints.accessFeasibility: Unknown; a separate condition, never a neutral numeric score
actualLabConstraints.dataPolicy: Use suitable lawfully usable public data where available; synthesize required unavailable fields/events; neither route establishes company readiness or business benefit.

unknownCostHandling: Scored dollar components are a provisional fictional benchmark, conditional on excluded purchases/licenses/access not crossing an anchor or reversing economics. Unknown additions are not zero and are not authorization. Actual lab feasibility and effort are outside these benchmark scores.

profileMeaning.low: Lower source/workload/effort and original lower benefit; favorable bounded company-source assumptions, not a probability forecast.
profileMeaning.base: Approved SCN benefit with explicit midpoint cost estimates and plausible bounded company-source assumptions.
profileMeaning.high: Higher source/workload/effort and original upper benefit; more difficult bounded company-source assumptions. Benefit upside is a sensitivity hypothesis, not an adopted replacement premise.

costing.priceBasis: Inherited dated portfolio assumptions/pricing reference, not a refreshed quote or actual bill.
unknownAdditions: Power BI and other incremental licenses
Additional historical remediation outside stated ranges

candidates.name: Receivables follow-up exceptions
candidates.benefitBasis: Base: 5 hours/week x 48 weeks x $50, net of added business review effort. Low/high retain the original portfolio opportunity band as sensitivity hypotheses; actual realization can be zero.

complexity.rationale: ERP transaction family plus owner reference; payment/credit allocation and disputes prevent a single simple extract score of 5. High burden assumes material lifecycle reconciliation.

data_readiness.rationale: Low burden assumes stable exports/keys with bounded gaps; base assumes usable extracts but material balance/rule work; high burden assumes missing allocation/history/definitions. No representative company data exist; no score of 5.

operational_risk.rationale: Advisory collection priority can affect customer relationships; require independent invoice/balance review and retain native aging fallback in every profile.

dependency_risk.rationale: Low burden assumes one bounded ERP-owner confirmation; base a material export/finance-owner dependency with workbook fallback; high burden multiple uncertain export/definition owners. Actual GCP/Power BI access is separate Unknown.

adverse.rationale: Residual addressable AR gap is half SCN-01 while additional allocation/history remediation raises effort above the original range; this stresses, rather than amends, the adopted premise.

candidates.name: Overdue purchase-order follow-up
candidates.benefitBasis: Base: 8 hours/week x 48 weeks x $50, net of added business review effort. Low/high retain the original portfolio opportunity band as sensitivity hypotheses; actual realization can be zero.

complexity.rationale: One ERP family plus buyer reference; partial receipts, cancellations and promise revisions are bounded rules at base. High burden assumes material event/lifecycle reconciliation; no automated contact.

data_readiness.rationale: Low burden assumes stable PO/receipt/cancel keys with bounded gaps; base needs material definition/history work; high burden assumes missing promise/cancel history. Synthetic chronology does not establish company readiness.

operational_risk.rationale: Base is a manually checked follow-up queue with reversible low-impact supplier contact and native-line fallback; high burden represents consequential prioritization errors. No automatic purchase, expedite or supplier-performance decision.

dependency_risk.rationale: Low burden assumes one bounded ERP-owner confirmation; base one material export/reference-owner dependency with native alerts/workbook fallback; high burden multiple uncertain owners. Actual lab access is separate Unknown.

adverse.rationale: Residual addressable PO gap is half SCN-02 while cancellation/promise-history remediation expands effort; buyer activity remains manual and scope is not replaced by automation.

candidates.name: Ship-by exception reporting
candidates.benefitBasis: Base: 3,000 addressable rework events/year x $10. Base equals the original portfolio lower endpoint; upper benefit requires stronger prevention/unit-value assumptions, not merely more generated late orders.

complexity.rationale: OMS and WMS require an order-line/shipment bridge, splits, cutoffs and corrections; low/base two well-defined source families, high difficult state/semantics. The daily action window is preserved.

data_readiness.rationale: Even low workload retains material cross-system join/cutoff reconciliation; high burden assumes major key/history gaps. Plausibility is a fictional premise, not representative source evidence.

operational_risk.rationale: Reviewed daily expedites remain consequential operational decisions with native queues as fallback. High burden assumes a shorter recovery window and greater service exposure; no autonomous dispatch.

dependency_risk.rationale: Low burden assumes coordinated source owners and plausible fallback; base/high retain multiple uncertain OMS/WMS owners and cutoff dependencies. Platform access is separate Unknown.

adverse.rationale: Half the base addressable rework remains while split/correction reconciliation adds effort and support; the unchanged daily route still must have an actionable morning window.
